The offline worker fetches this site's own files while it installs, passes a request through for a file it does not hold, and fetches a serif face the first time it is used so it can keep it. Its policy is connect-src 'self'.

Viz.js (Graphviz layout, bundled in @plantuml/core) runs only in the sandboxed PlantUML frame, whose policy is connect-src 'none' (docs/local.md, Diagram engines): its loader code for fetching the WebAssembly is never reached, because the module is embedded in the file.

The draw.io viewer fetches label pictures and proxied data sources. It runs only in the sandboxed draw.io frame, whose policy is connect-src 'none' and img-src data: (docs/local.md, Diagram engines), so neither call can leave the frame.

The draw.io viewer loads stencil sets, styles and proxied files with XMLHttpRequest. It runs only in the sandboxed draw.io frame, whose policy is connect-src 'none' (docs/local.md, Diagram engines); the page fetches the stencil sets itself and passes them in.

The draw.io viewer evaluates function text in stencils and style sheets (mxUtils.eval). The sandboxed draw.io frame allows no unsafe-eval, and the frame replaces mxUtils.eval with a function that returns null, so none of it runs.
